questions.stem_text:
Scientists are concerned about the presence of heavy metals like lead and mercury in the
environment because

options.A: heavy metals threaten some forms of life.
options.B: heavy metals will increase available resources.
options.C: exposure to heavy metals causes healthy mutations.
options.D: mining for heavy metals causes environmental stability.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - heavy metals threaten some forms of life.
